SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT target AS BUYER , KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO , KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ , KEY_3 AS REVISION , KEY_4 AS MSDS_NO FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MSDS' AND TARGET IN (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSYSE0001' AND TYPE = 'PLNT') AND KEY_9 = '3' ORDER BY TARGET,KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.PLANT , RQDT.MSDS_NO AS ITEM_NO , SUBSTRB(RQDT.DESCRIPTION,1,30) as DESCRIPTION , RQDT.MAKER_NAME , RQDT.ORIGIN_NAME , RQDT.UNIT_MEASURE , SUBSTRB(NVL(CASE WHEN RQDT.BTOA_USER_ID='SAMYANGBP' THEN DECODE(LOWER(SUBSTR(BTOA_AGENT_NAME,1,2)),'sy',BTOA_AGENT_NAME,'syc195366') WHEN RQDT.BTOA_USER_ID = 'SYC210026' THEN DECODE(LOWER(SUBSTR(BTOA_AGENT_NAME,1,2)),'sy',BTOA_AGENT_NAME,'syc210026') ELSE (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = RQDT.BTOA_USER_ID) END, RQDT.BTOA_USER_ID),1,10) AS BTOA_USER_ID , RQDT.SPECIFICATION , '' AS MIXTURE_YN , MSDS.CAS_NO , '' AS UN_NO , RQDT.ATOB_DATE , RQDT.ATOB_TIME , decode(substr(RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7),'NO_CODE','', RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , BUYER||'/'||QUOTATION_NO||'/'||QUOTATION_SEQ AS KEP_KEY , NVL(TRIM(RQDT.PLANT), (SELECT MAX(CODE) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSYSE0001' AND TYPE = 'PLNT' AND TEXT4 = RQDT.BUYER)) AS CENTER_CD FROM kep.KEPRQDT RQDT, kep.KEPMSDSHD MSDS WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND RQDT.MSDS_NO = MSDS.MSDS_NO
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET key_9 = 'Y' , key_10 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE doc_name = 'MSDS' and target = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND key_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND key_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND key_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_9 = '3'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET key_9 = 'E' , key_10 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE doc_name = 'MSDS' and target = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND key_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND key_2 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND key_3 = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND KEY_9 = '3'
